cues: Before eighteen fifty one, harvesting honey usually meant destroying the colony.
Then Langstroth noticed that bees always leave a gap of about six to nine millimetres, the bee space, which they never fill.
Build a box with frames spaced exactly that far apart, and every frame lifts out undamaged.
Every modern hive is his movable frame hive.
